customers.label: Customers
customers.definition: Customers (individual consumers and SMEs) by country as stated in Nu Holdings' 2025 Form 20-F; published rounded to the nearest million ('113 million', 'reached 14 million', 'surpassed 4 million') and stored as people.

source.label: Nu Holdings 2025 Form 20-F, Item 4 business overview
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had 131 million customers. In Brazil we had 113 million customers, which represented approximately 62% of the country's population aged 18 and above. [113 million = 113,000,000]

source.label: Nu Holdings 2025 Form 20-F, Item 4 business overview
source.quote: In Mexico, we reached 14 million customers, advanced our banking license process, and saw approximately half of our customers receive their first credit card through Nu, underscoring our role in expanding access to credit. [14 million = 14,000,000]

source.label: Nu Holdings 2025 Form 20-F, Item 4 business overview
source.quote: In Colombia, we have surpassed 4 million customers, and with the recent expansion of our credit card portfolio, we are now able to approve nearly three times more applicants with our fee-led card strategy, implemented in 2024 and expanded throughout 2025. [4 million = 4,000,000]

notes: Customers by country are stated in the FY2025 Form 20-F text (total 131 million at Dec 31, 2025). Brazil is 113 million; Mexico 'reached 14 million' (stored as 14,000,000); Colombia 'surpassed 4 million' (stored as 4,000,000 with plus). The 20-F gives employees only by function (10,027 total), not by country; it says all employees were based in offices in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Uruguay and the United States. Sites are from the offices table in Item 4.D as of Dec 31, 2025 (Querétaro, Palo Alto, Montevideo and Zug coworking offices omitted as minor; the Bogotá office grew to 23,301 sq ft). The Durham office is listed as 'Durham, USA' with no state, so no state code is set. No U.S. state data.
